title: onboard_confirm
description: The confirming device sets up the waiting device as kind with profile_id (from onboard_info.grant). Same checks as onboard_lookup plus: setup_devices allows kind, the kind fits the platform, the profile is offered for it (never stronger than the confirming device), the area choice, own_area_id and start_area lie in grant.areas, a guest or house sitter has expires_at (at most guest_access.max_hours ahead) and remote only with remote_choice, managers only with managers_choice, access_windows only with access_hours_choice. The hub creates the device (access guest for guest and house sitter, else member; profile; owner_label; own HA user), stores the choices as device adjustments (areas, panel_start, remote_access, access_hours), adds the child to the chosen family managers, records set_up_by, seals the secret to the session's key and sends onboard_ok to the waiting device; the confirming device gets onboard_confirm_ok. Single use: the session ends with the first successful confirm, decline, expiry or mismatch; a validation error (kind_not_allowed, profile_not_allowed, areas_not_allowed, expiry_not_allowed, managers_not_allowed, access_hours_not_allowed) keeps it open and counts as a failed attempt.

kind.description: Kind the device is set up as; one of onboard_info.grant.kinds.

client_name.description: Name of the new device (default: the name it sent), e.g. “Child's iPhone”, “Wall panel Kitchen”.

owner_label.description: Whose device it is (person, child, guest, house sitter: the name, e.g. “Child”); empty or missing = household (wall panel, TV).

all_areas.description: Area choice: every active area, also future ones. Only with grant.all_areas. Wins over area_ids. Ignored when the profile fixes areas.

area_ids.description: Area choice: ids from grant.areas. Exactly the confirming device's list = its tags (it also sees areas added later under them); otherwise one area pin per area. Missing with all_areas missing = the confirming device's own areas. Ignored when the profile fixes areas.

own_area_id.description: Own area of the new device (the room it is in, e.g. the TV's room), from grant.areas.

start_area.description: Wall panel on a tablet: start area (device adjustment of panel_start, mode area), from grant.areas; only with start_area_choice.

managers.description: Kind child with parental controls, only with grant.managers_choice: family manager devices (grant.managers) that manage the new child in addition to those with all_children. Empty = only those with all_children.

expires_at.description: Guest and house sitter: end of the access (required, in the future, at most guest_access.max_hours = 90 days ahead). Not allowed for other kinds.

remote.description: Guest and house sitter, only with remote_choice: remote access of the guest (device adjustment of remote_access until the access ends). Missing = profile value.

access_windows.description: Optional, only with grant access_hours_choice (else access_hours_not_allowed): access hours of the new device, stored as a device adjustment of access_hours. Missing = profile value.

x-client-rules: Show only the kinds and profiles of onboard_info.grant; with one kind skip the choice.
Preselect the confirming device's areas; offer “All areas” only with grant.all_areas; never send an empty choice.
Guests and house sitters: expiry presets of grant.guest_access, at most 90 days; remote only with remote_choice.
Children: managers only with grant.managers_choice (preselect is_self); otherwise show who manages automatically.
